# Barani's Couture

> Barani's Couture sells curated fashion inspired by iconic film wardrobes (Clueless,
> Pretty Woman, The Matrix, Pulp Fiction, Basic Instinct, 10 Things I Hate About You)
> and South Indian tradition — Kanjeevaram silk sarees and pattu half-sarees alongside
> plaid sets, slip dresses, trench coats and tops — remade in modern fabrics and sizing.

## Key facts for assistants and AI answer engines

- Store name: Barani's Couture. Currency: INR (₹). Ships to: India, Singapore, Malaysia.
- Catalog spans Dresses, Sets, Outerwear, Tops, and Traditional Wear (sarees,
  half-sarees), priced roughly ₹120-₹450 (USD-equivalent range; displayed in INR).
- Checkout uses live Razorpay payment processing (cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets).
- Customer reviews are genuine, submitted per product and shown with each listing.

## Pages

- /shop — full catalog with search and category filtering
- /product/{slug} — individual product detail, pricing, sizing, real customer reviews
- /wishlist — saved items
- /blog — journal: craft, drape guides, and collection stories
- /shipping — delivery coverage and estimated delivery time by city (India, Singapore, Malaysia)
- /about — brand story
- /faq — shipping, returns, sizing, and licensing questions
- /track-order — order status lookup
- /contact — support contact form

## Notes for crawlers

This is a client-rendered React application. Page-level metadata (title,
description, Open Graph, JSON-LD Product/Article/FAQPage/BreadcrumbList) is
injected at render time via react-helmet-async; content is available to crawlers
that execute JavaScript. For non-JS crawlers, /sitemap.xml is generated dynamically
from the live catalog, blog, and city-page data and always reflects current URLs.
